name: Sexual Purity
overview: Scripture calls believers to a life of sexual purity by guarding their hearts and minds against lust, as Jesus teaches that even looking with lust is equivalent to adultery in the heart (Matthew 5:28). The Psalms urge us to turn away our eyes from vanity and to seek God's guidance in ordering our steps to prevent sin's dominion (Psalms 119:37, 133). Romans emphasizes the believer's identity as dead to sin and alive in Christ, encouraging a transformation through the renewing of the mind and putting on Christ to resist fleshly desires (Romans 6:11; 12:2; 13:14). Together, these verses reveal that sexual purity is maintained through active spiritual renewal and reliance on Christ's power rather than conforming to worldly lusts.
